decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.1505. Series context: trend strength 0.9907 and seasonal strength 0.0861; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.454); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 63.189.
